CustomField.description: TNCI-206 / ELV-DM-010. Nue port of CPQ Exclude_ARR_Formula__c (misleading name; TRUE means include). TRUE when the line is not excluded from ARR, has non-zero quantity, and is not a Summary Item. Summary Items are excluded from ARR aggregation to avoid double counting against Product lines.
CustomField.formula: AND( NOT( ELV_Exclude_from_ARR__c ), Ruby__ActualQuantity__c <> 0, NOT( ISPICKVAL( Ruby__LineType__c, "SummaryItem" ) ) )
CustomField.inlineHelpText: TRUE when this line is included in ARR calculations. Summary Items are excluded.
CustomField.label: ELV Include in ARR Calc
